summary.text: Scott Wyatt is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 60th District since 2020.
The district covers part of Hanover County and part of New Kent County.
The House profile lists Scott Wyatt's occupation as telecommunications manager (retired).

paragraphs.text: Scott Wyatt was born in Richmond, VA.
The profile lists Henrico High School (1981), J. Sargeant Reynolds Community College and Virginia Commonwealth University under education.
The profile lists the Catholic Church of the Redeemer, the Knights of Columbus, the Mechanicsville Ruritan Club and the Mechanicsville Businessmen's Association.
Scott Wyatt serves on the Transportation, Counties, Cities and Towns, and Appropriations committees.
